source.commentary: Darakaraka (planet with lowest longitude) activates marriage during its operative period.

interpretation: Darakaraka (DK), the supreme Jaimini significator of spouse and union, directly brings marriage when its period operates.

source.commentary: Activation of Upapada Lagna (UL) lord or planets placed in Upapada.

interpretation: Upapada Lagna (UL) represents the physical manifestation of marriage; its lord's period brings formal wedding.
